hook: 字根 rupt＝破——哪裡一響，哪裡就裂。
script: 談判 abrupt 突然中斷；制度 corrupt 從內部破爛。抗議 disrupt 打亂秩序，火山 erupt 噴出。bankrupt 破產，rupture 是裂口；interrupt 从中打斷，irrupt 衝破闖入。

members.speakLineEn: An abrupt transition confused the audience.
members.speakLineZh: 突然的轉折讓聽眾困惑。

members.speakLineEn: New tools disrupt old workflows—and old hierarchies.
members.speakLineZh: 新工具擾亂舊流程——以及舊階層。

members.senseAnchor: start abruptly; erupt or intensify suddenly

related.synonyms: irrupt, flare, ignite, combust, conflagrate, belch

members.speakLineEn: The theory is morally bankrupt if it excuses harm.
members.speakLineZh: 若為傷害開脫，該理論在道德上已破產。

members.senseAnchor: state of being torn or burst open; a personal or social separation (as between opposing factions)
members.speakLineEn: A rupture between method and claim is fatal.
members.speakLineZh: 方法與主張之間的裂口是致命的。

related.synonyms: breach, break, severance, rift, tear, snap
related.antonyms: keep, conform to, make, promote, repair, inelasticity

members.speakLineEn: Please do not interrupt the operational definition.
members.speakLineZh: 請不要打斷操作型定義。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

members.speakLineEn: An irruption of cases overwhelmed the clinic model.
members.speakLineZh: 病例突然湧入壓垮了診所模型。

members.speakLineEn: The eruption of outrage was predictable.
members.speakLineZh: 憤怒的爆發其實可預期。

members.speakLineEn: Data corruption invalidated the third trial.
members.speakLineZh: 資料損壞使第三次試驗無效。

members.speakLineEn: Disruptive claims need stronger evidence, not louder ads.
members.speakLineZh: 顛覆式宣稱需要更強證據，而非更大聲廣告。

reviewHooks: rupt＝破：abrupt 驟斷、corrupt 內爛、disrupt 打亂、erupt 噴出
bankrupt＝銀行／帳面破裂；rupture＝裂口本身
pitfalls: abrupt 指突然，不一定負面，但常帶生硬感
corrupt 可作形容詞或動詞
